drafts.subject: Re: Quick question about byLLM structured output
drafts.message:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for reaching out with your inquiry. byLLM does indeed support structured outputs for parsing log lines into predefined fields. You can configure the model to handle typed outputs directly, which should suit your log triage needs effectively.

If you have any further questions or need assistance with setup, feel free to contact us.

Best regards,
Impact Team
